validation_queries.description: Check for hipFile PMC metric descriptions
validation_queries.error_message: No hipFile PMC info rows found in rocpd_info_pmc
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} WHERE name LIKE 'device_storage_%'

validation_queries.description: Check for hipFile per-GPU byte counter descriptions
validation_queries.error_message: hipFile 'Read Bytes' / 'Write Bytes' PMC info not found
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT symbol) as count FROM {table_name} WHERE name LIKE 'device_storage_%' AND symbol IN ('Read Bytes', 'Write Bytes')

validation_queries.description: Check for the hipFile fastpath/fallback split
validation_queries.error_message: hipFile fastpath/fallback PMC info not found
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT symbol) as count FROM {table_name} WHERE name LIKE 'device_storage_%' AND symbol IN ('Fastpath Reads', 'Fallback Reads', 'Fastpath Writes', 'Fallback Writes')

validation_queries.description: Check hipFile byte counters carry the same units as the other byte metrics
validation_queries.error_message: hipFile byte counters are not registered with units 'bytes'
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} WHERE symbol IN ('Read Bytes', 'Write Bytes') AND units != 'bytes'

validation_queries.description: Check hipFile bandwidth carries the same units as PCIe instantaneous bandwidth
validation_queries.error_message: hipFile bandwidth is not registered with units 'bytes/s'
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} WHERE symbol IN ('Read Bandwidth', 'Write Bandwidth') AND units != 'bytes/s'

validation_queries.description: Check no process-scoped hipFile counters are registered
validation_queries.error_message: hipFile process-scoped registration counters are still being registered; they were removed because they are not GPU measurements
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} WHERE symbol IN ('File Registrations', 'Buffer Registrations')

validation_queries.description: Check for hipFile PMC counter events in trace
validation_queries.error_message: No hipFile PMC events found in rocpd_pmc_event
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} event JOIN rocpd_info_pmc info ON event.pmc_id = info.id WHERE info.name LIKE 'device_storage_%'

validation_queries.description: Check that at least one hipFile byte counter is non-zero
validation_queries.error_message: Every hipFile byte counter was zero: rows exist but no I/O was actually measured
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} event JOIN rocpd_info_pmc info ON event.pmc_id = info.id WHERE info.symbol IN ('Read Bytes', 'Write Bytes') AND event.value > 0

validation_queries.description: Check that at least one hipFile operation counter is non-zero
validation_queries.error_message: Every hipFile operation counter was zero: no read or write operations were attributed to a GPU
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} event JOIN rocpd_info_pmc info ON event.pmc_id = info.id WHERE info.symbol IN ('Read Ops', 'Write Ops') AND event.value > 0

validation_queries.description: Check hipFile byte counters never decrease between non-zero samples
validation_queries.error_message: A hipFile byte counter decreased between samples; the counters are published cumulative, so a drop means per-interval deltas were emitted instead
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM (SELECT event.value AS value, LAG(event.value) OVER (PARTITION BY event.pmc_id ORDER BY event.event_id) AS previous FROM {table_name} event JOIN rocpd_info_pmc info ON event.pmc_id = info.id WHERE info.symbol IN ('Read Bytes', 'Write Bytes') AND event.value > 0) WHERE previous IS NOT NULL AND value < previous
